description: Price in EUR of one coin on 1 January 00:00 Dutch time (31 December 23:00 UTC) of the given year, per exchange platform. Omit platform to get all platforms. Includes candleTime and kind ("open" of that hour, or "close" of the last earlier hour) and the URL of the coin page.

coin.description: Coin ticker, name or slug, case-insensitive, e.g. "BTC", "bitcoin", "eth", "ripple".

platform.description: Exchange platform where the coins were held.

year.description: Reference year: prices on 1 January of this year (for the tax return over that year). Available: 2014–2026.

name: get_reference_price
title: Reference-date price
